target_customer: Homeowners and small builders who want custom house plans cheaper than an architect; paid plan sets planned at about $1,000
problem: Custom home design is slow and expensive, and stock plans are rigid.
business_model: Free AI floor plan tool with paid construction plan sets

founders.name: Nicholas Donahue
previous_startups: Atmos, custom home design, YC, shut down in 2025
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch: parents were in home building. Atmos reached 40 people and about $7M revenue before high interest rates hurt customers.

competitors.name: Maket
competitors.what: AI floor planning tool with 3D visualization

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating architecturally feasible, code-aware plans with exportable CAD from multimodal models is hard; outputs face criticism on feasibility.

defensibility.rationale: Usage data from hundreds of thousands of designs may help, but many AI floor plan tools exist and the front end is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response reported in sources.

market_need_then: Founder cites the gap between expensive architects and stock plans; usage reports of 120,000 users and 325,000 designs in a month (company launch claims) suggest strong consumer interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses drafted.ai, not the .com; no purchase story found

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and benefit focused, 'Design House Plans Instantly with AI'

branding.community_and_virality: Hacker News launch and press coverage including TechCrunch; 120k users reported by the company.

brand_strength.rationale: Product-led virality and press from a known founder; the name itself is generic and no brand assets are documented.

outcome_analysis: Drafted is a repeat founder's second attempt at home design after Atmos shut down in 2025. It raised $1.65M pre-seed in December 2025 and a reported $16M seed in May 2026, helped by fast consumer usage of a free AI tool. Open questions are plan quality and converting free users to paid plan sets.
notes: Seed amount conflicts: most outlets say $16M, one (AI Business Weekly) says $17.5M. Seed date given as May 2026 without a day. Seed investor list comes from secondary outlets, not the company. Dealroom lists the pre-seed as $1.6M. Atmos funding figures differ across sources ($12.5M vs $20M). Maket and others are competitors but their dates were not found.
